text: People online say the characters 射 and 矮 got swapped.
say: People online say the characters, Shè and Ǎi, got swapped.
asr: People online say the characters, Shah and I, got swapped.

text: 射 is 身 (body) plus 寸 (inch). One inch tall: isn’t that short?
say: Shè, is Shēn, body, plus Tsun, inch. One inch tall: isn't that short?
asr: Shut is shin body plus son inch one inch tall isn't that short?

text: On the left of 矮 is 矢, an arrow; on the right is 委, to let go. Letting an arrow go: isn’t that shooting?
say: On the left of Ǎi is Shǐ, an arrow; on the right is Wěi, to let go. Letting an arrow go: isn't that shooting?
asr: On the left of I is sure an arrow on the right is way to let go. Letting an arrow go, isn't that shooting?

text: In fact, the oldest 射 is a bow with an arrow on it.
say: In fact, the oldest Shè is a bow with an arrow on it.
asr: In fact, the oldest shur is a bow with an arrow on it.

text: Later a hand was added, pulling the string.
The bow slowly became 身, and the hand became 寸.
say: The bow became Shēn, and the hand became Tsun.
asr: The bow became shin and the hand became son.

text: Why is there an arrow in 矮? People once used arrows as rulers to measure length. That is why 短 (short) has one too.
say: Why is there an arrow in Ǎi? People once used arrows as rulers to measure length. That is why Duǎn, short, has one too.
asr: Why is there an arrow in eye? People once used arrows as rulers to measure length. That is why Dwan Short has won too.

text: 射 means drawing a bow and shooting; 矮 means short, and 委 only gives the sound.
say: Shè means drawing a bow and shooting. Ai means short, and Wěi only gives the sound.
asr: She means drawing a bow and shooting. AI means short, and Wei only gives the sound.
